pedals.axis.rudder.name: Rudder
pedals.axis.rudder.note: central tower carrying both pendular pedal arms

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), seen from the pilot's seat, slightly from the left; left pedal in front on the left
mappingSource: catalog source TPR Rudder user manual (https://ts.thrustmaster.com/download/accessories/Manuals/TPR/TPR_Rudder_User_Manual.pdf): rudder axis + 2 differential toe-brake axes; axes only, no buttons
note: The rudder is the pendular swing of both pedal arms (pivot in the central tower); the marker sits on the tower. Each toe brake is the tilt of its pedal plate; the markers sit on the upper (toe) part of the plates.
